title: Ethiopian Garden Salad
author: Chef Haile
desc: Ethiopian Garden Salad — a mixed salad of lettuce, tomato, cucumber, carrot, and onion dressed with lemon, olive oil, and a touch of jalapeño. The modern Ethiopian restaurant salad — a familiar format with Ethiopian dressing.
longDesc: The Ethiopian garden salad is the modern restaurant's nod to international dining expectations — a recognisable mixed salad format but dressed with the bright lemon and jalapeño that characterise Ethiopian fresh preparations.
steps: Combine all vegetables in a bowl.
Dress with lemon juice, oil, and salt.
chefTips: Dress at the last moment — lettuce wilts quickly.
cookingScience: The jalapeño's capsaicin dissolves partially into the oil component of the dressing — distributing a mild heat through the salad rather than concentrating it in specific pieces.
sustainabilityTips: All vegetables grown in Ethiopian highlands.
servedWith: As a starter at Ethiopian restaurants
culturalNote: The Ethiopian garden salad is modern Ethiopia's international greeting — a salad that any international visitor recognises immediately, dressed in the way that is unmistakably Ethiopian.
